instruction: A candid outdoor photograph shows a sunny beach with a volleyball net. In a full shot, the woman in the black bikini (R2) on the left and the man in the blue tank top (R1) on the right walk forward on the sand. The woman (R2) smiles up at the man (R1) as they high-five with their raised inner hands. The man (R1), wearing sunglasses, smiles back. She carries an orange tote bag and a white bottle, while he holds a blue water bottle. Bright, warm daylight casts soft shadows on the sand, creating a cheerful, relaxed atmosphere.
